name: Nadhew
source:
Nadhew is a demon from Annwn. Being a demon, he tends to be impolite, atrocious, and spontaneous, and takes pleasure in picking on others. He likes to see how far he can push people, and is extremely mischievous. When it comes to romance, Nadhew tends to equate love with power. Since he becomes clumsy with serious romantic love, he takes a more playful approach.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/fragrance/fragrance.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
